newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close softer, seen firming.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close softer, seen firming.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closer lower on Thursday but dealers said they expected the rates to inch higher on Friday over expected routine monthly payroll demand.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.470 percent from Wednesday's 5.552, with 30-day commercial paper down to 5.40 from 5.60-5.75. Liquidity was loose at the beginning of a new reserve period and dealers expected the interbank rate to move around 5.500 percent in coming sessions.
The bond market reported no trade in the afternoon, with investors focussed on the central bank's scheduled September 12 board meeting, traders said. - Julie Hu (2-5080815)
